baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative construction puts a cord at the front neck and then specifies its masad construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cord capable of binding and leading is fixed at the body's exposed steering point, while masad supplies a tightly twisted build. The three focus nouns compose a tension-bearing halter rather than an object merely resting near the neck.

activation_trace.role: Locates the mechanism on the exposed front neck, where a tether can redirect the whole body.
Supplies an extended cord that binds or leads, giving the neck object restraint and directional force.
Supplies firmly twisted fibrous construction, making the restraint durable under tension.

changed_reading.before: A rope happens to be worn at her neck.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately constructed halter occupies the bodily point from which a person can be bound, led, and denied self-direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places a named cord-form at a neck, the ordinary display site of a necklace, but qualifies it with coarse twisted material.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ornament branch of the cord root and the neck's display associations establish a necklace slot; masad fills that slot with hard-twisted fiber. Adornment is not simply absent but structurally retained and materially reversed.

activation_trace.role: Provides the front neck as a conspicuous display site, including the lexical association with a fine or elongated neck.
Activates a cord-derived ornament specifically placed among necklace elements.
Replaces ornamental fineness with forcefully twisted palm, hair, or hide fiber.

changed_reading.before: The neck rope is only an instrument of restraint.
changed_reading.after: The restraint is also an anti-necklace: the form and display position of adornment survive while its material and function turn punitive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus word that denotes a material cord can denote covenant, protection, attachment, or a means of access, and it is fixed at her neck.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bond normally providing connection or security becomes inseparable from the bearer and changes polarity into encumbrance. Masad's twisting gives the social bond a material image: separate ties become one constricting liability.

activation_trace.role: Supplies covenant, protection, attachment, and means of access as a second functional register for the cord.
Turns an abstract bond into something borne visibly at a vulnerable bodily site.
Gives multiple connective strands a single tightened and load-bearing form.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only a physical cord.
changed_reading.after: It can simultaneously stage a bond of protection or affiliation whose very closeness has inverted into bodily liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cord root carries both hunting-snare and ensnaring-calamity branches, while the focus fixes the result around the neck.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cord is an active capture system rather than passive equipment. The neck location shows the trap already closed, and the twisted material suggests tightening under struggle.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a catching and entangling trap, converting the cord into an event of capture.
Adds calamity or cunning that catches its own subject, making entanglement consequential rather than accidental.
Marks the neck as the point at which capture has become bodily control.
Supplies torsion and tensile coherence, allowing the trap to close rather than fall apart.

changed_reading.before: The rope is a static punishment imposed after capture.
changed_reading.after: The rope is itself the closing trap, with the focus presenting the instant of entanglement as a settled bodily condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: At the neck, the cord root can name bodily veins and sinews, while masad can describe a compactly twisted human form.
baseline_models.mechanism: External rope and bodily cord become analogues. The restraint does not merely touch the body; its corded structure echoes the body's own connective tissues and tightly formed shape, making captivity appear incorporated.

activation_trace.role: Provides the anatomical site at which external tether and internal bodily structures can meet.
Supplies vein-like, sinew-like, and joint-like cords inside the body.
Supplies a human body understood as tightly formed or corded, extending twist from material to physique.

changed_reading.before: A foreign object is attached to an otherwise separate body.
changed_reading.after: The body itself is rendered cord-like, so that the imposed constraint seems to invade and reorganize embodiment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening destruction and cutting of hands, read through hand-as-power and the split root's supported strength, removes the ordinary organ and symbol of agency. The focus halter then relocates control to the neck: active mastery is reversed into being led.

activation_trace.role: Supplies severance, allowing the repeated opening verb to remove operative control rather than indicate loss only.
Supplies the hand as power, expanding bodily destruction into a collapse of capacity.
Supplies the hand as authority, sharpening the reversal from governing to being governed.
The non-dominant mapped root adds reinforced strength, so the loss can include support as well as anatomy.
Provides the neck as the replacement center on which control is exercised.
Provides the binding and leading apparatus that converts lost agency into directed subjection.

structural_cues: 111:1 repeats the destruction verb around the hand-and-name phrase; 111:5 shifts the decisive bodily site from hands to neck.
The focus is a fixed locative nominal condition rather than a passing action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cut or destroyed hands, hand-as-power or authority, supported strength, and a neck halter; I infer a control-vector reversal across the household. A live alternative is that the two bodily images remain parallel punishments without transfer.

changed_reading.before: The neck rope restrains its bearer without reference to prior agency.
changed_reading.after: It completes a bodily reversal in which power formerly figured by hands is removed and the household is now figured from the neck, the point by which one is led.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sufficiency, accumulated property, and successfully sought benefit form the expected components of security. Because the context explicitly denies their efficacy, the focus cord's protection-and-access branch reverses: accumulated means become strands twisted into the snare they were meant to prevent.

activation_trace.role: Supplies adequacy and sufficiency, the protective function that the negative clause denies.
Supplies the taking and multiplying of property, giving the failed security an accretive material logic.
Supplies deliberate pursuit and attainment of benefit, making the eventual liability partly produced rather than merely received.
Provides the expected functions of protection, attachment, and reaching a goal that wealth and gain fail to perform.
Reverses the failed means into an entangling trap.
Turns repeated acquisition into a strand-by-strand image of one tightened liability.

structural_cues: 111:2 coordinates property and what was acquired under a repeated negation of availing.
The focus material complement follows the cord, inviting the prior plurality of means to be recomposed as one object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied sufficiency, accumulated property, acquired benefit, a protective cord, a snare, and twisted strands; I infer that failed means feed the construction of the trap. The live alternative is simple non-availing followed by an unrelated physical punishment.

changed_reading.before: A protective bond has somehow become a burden.
changed_reading.after: The very means accumulated for sufficiency and protection are imaginatively twisted into the neck-snare, so acquisition supplies the material logic of its own reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Encounter with heat, fire used to ignite or reshape, burning that can brand, and active flame meet a cord made of firmly twisted organic fiber. The neck rope can therefore be read as a wick-like tether that couples its bearer to the fire rather than as a restraint spatially unrelated to it.

activation_trace.role: Supplies direct encounter with fire and heat as the destination of the mechanism.
Supplies ignition and fire-driven reshaping, making heat an active transformer rather than scenery.
Supplies burning fire together with its capacity to leave a bodily mark.
Supplies the moving tongue and active spread of flame that the tether can conduct.
Provides an extended physical path from neck outward.
Provides tightly twisted palm, hair, or hide fiber that can be imagined as a heat-bearing wick.

structural_cues: The future fire encounter in 111:3 is followed by the carrier and then the neck apparatus in 111:4-5.
The material specification in the focus makes physical analogy more available than a generic cord would.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire contact, ignition, branding, flame, and twisted organic cord; I supply the directional arrow that the cord conducts or extends the fire like a wick. It may instead remain a non-burning tether merely co-present with fire.

changed_reading.before: The rope restrains while fire punishes elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The rope becomes a material coupling or fuse, bringing the fire's action to the neck and making restraint and burning one process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Both mapped inventories for the fire-encounter form independently retain trap branches, and the focus cord has its own snare branch. This three-way branch convergence turns the sequence into entrapment whose terminal environment is fire, without forcing either mapped root to disappear.

activation_trace.role: The dominant mapped inventory supplies laid snares and traps, linking the fire-clause form to capture.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently supplies set traps, preserving rather than collapsing the split-root activation.
Keeps direct fire encounter as the consequence or location reached by the trapping mechanism.
Provides the focus-anchored snare that visibly closes around the neck.

The fire clause precedes the neck-snare image, permitting capture and destination to form a sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two independent trap branches, direct fire encounter, and a neck snare; I infer capture leading into fire. The alternative is accidental polysemous overlap with no causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus rope is one possible snare image among many cord senses.
changed_reading.after: The two mapped inventories of the preceding fire verb both reactivate that snare, making entrapment a repeated lexical mechanism rather than a solitary metaphor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire that marks, is visible from afar, or stands out clearly combines with elevated flame and the focus's necklace-like display position. The anti-necklace becomes a public badge of the relation to flame, not merely a private constriction.

activation_trace.role: Adds fire as a means of marking, allowing punishment to function as an impressed sign.
Adds fire perceived at a distance, shifting the mechanism toward public visibility.
Supplies manifest projection or obviousness, sharpening the neck object's display function.
Supplies elevated flame-like prominence, making the associated sign conspicuous.
Provides the visible front neck as the bodily display surface.
Provides the necklace-ornament template that can be inverted into a stigmatic badge.

structural_cues: The same flame term appears first inside a name and later as the explicit quality of the fire.
The focus places its object at the front neck, a naturally legible rather than concealed site.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marking fire, distant visibility, manifest prominence, flame, and neck ornament; I infer that the anti-necklace displays identity or outcome publicly. The live alternative is that all visibility belongs to the fire while the rope remains purely constrictive.

changed_reading.before: The inverted necklace substitutes rough restraint for ornament.
changed_reading.after: It also operates as a conspicuous anti-insignia, making the bearer's flame-linked condition visible on the body's display surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated external carrying, a carrying implement, and gathered fuel immediately precede a twisted cord at the carrier's neck. The focus rope becomes load-bearing equipment for an ongoing labor system, joining task, apparatus, and body.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the lifting and bearing of an external load as the action the neck apparatus serves.
Supplies a carrying tool or mount, licensing an apparatus reading rather than burden alone.
Supplies fuel as material repeatedly gathered into the load.
Locates the rig at the bodily point used to bear or control its tension.
Supplies the extended tether or halter that joins carrier to load.
Makes the rig a robust twisted implement suited to repeated strain.

structural_cues: The intensive feminine carrier noun and its definite load in 111:4 flow directly into the feminine possessive neck clause in 111:5.
The focus clause names apparatus, body location, and construction after the task has already been named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated carrying, an external load, carrying equipment, gathered fuel, and a neck tether; I infer that the rope is the rig coupling bearer and load. It can alternatively be a separate collar with no hauling function.

changed_reading.before: The rope is a finished restraint displayed on the carrier.
changed_reading.after: It is also her work harness, making the punishment durative: she remains structurally attached to the task of gathering and bearing fuel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bearing blame, carrying slander between people, and indiscriminately mixing what is gathered activate the cord's social-connection and snare branches. Repeated circulation of mixed reports is imagined as twisting relational threads until the carrier is caught by the network she sustains.

activation_trace.role: Converts physical bearing into the carrying of blame, entrusted burden, or culpable weight.
Supplies the social act of carrying hostile reports or slander from person to person.
Adds indiscriminate gathering and mixture, explaining how heterogeneous reports accumulate.
Supplies interpersonal connection and attachment as the channels through which reports travel.
Turns the network of connections into a trap for the person maintaining it.
Provides twisting as the material analogue by which repeated social threads become one constricting rope.

structural_cues: The intensive carrier form supports recurrence rather than a single act.
The material fuel sense and the packet's explicit social-carrying branch coexist at the same context word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies culpable bearing, slander circulation, mixed gathering, social connection, snare, and twist; I infer the return arrow by which circulated reports bind their carrier. The alternatives are literal fuel carriage or moral burden without a network mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The neck rope is imposed independently of the carrier's social action.
changed_reading.after: It materializes the social channels she repeatedly works: many carried reports twist those connections into the snare that closes on their carrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: A relational form of address, a flame-derived personal title, explicit identification as the man's wife, and the carrying root's surety branch converge on the focus cord as covenant or attachment. The neck bond becomes household affiliation functioning as guarantee and shared liability.

Supplies covenant, protection, and attachment as the legal-social substance of the neck bond.
Makes shared liability visible and personally borne rather than merely conceptual.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relational naming, a flame title, wife identification, surety, and a covenant cord; I infer that the spousal bond is rendered as shared household liability. A live alternative is that surety and covenant branches do not interact and the rope remains only individual punishment.

changed_reading.before: The cord is an inverted protective bond without a specified social relation.
changed_reading.after: The context specifies that bond as spousal and household affiliation: what could secure belonging now acts like surety for a shared liability borne at her neck.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The final object closes the fuel-carrying mechanism as binding gear.** Branch evidence: `ج ي د` B001, neck/front of neck; `ح ب ل` B001, extended cord for binding or leading; `م س د` B001, twisted rope; earlier `ح م ل` B006, carrying gear/strap; `ح ط ب` B001, gathered fuel. Structural cue: after she is named a carrier, the next ayah locates a rope at the neck. Assigned role: rope becomes the harness or binding apparatus of the carrying scene. Abductive move: I infer that the neck-rope is the visible equipment that attaches the carrier to the carried burden and its consequence. Reading change: the ayah is not a separate punishment detail; it completes the material logistics of carrying fuel.

2. **Covenant and protection are inverted into constriction.** Branch evidence: `ح ب ل` B002, covenant/protection/connection; `ج ي د` B001, neck; `م س د` B001, firm twisting; earlier `ر ح م` B002, kinship bond; `غ ن ي` B002, availing/protecting. Structural cue: the packet begins with mercy/kinship and passes through failed wealth-protection before ending with a bond around the throat. Assigned role: the rope supplies the same semantic form as connection, but its local placement makes connection punitive. Abductive move: I infer that bonds can reverse valence when the relation they preserve is destructive. Reading change: the final rope reads as failed covenant or corrupted kinship made bodily tight.

3. **The neck ornament is converted into coarse rope.** Branch evidence: `ج ي د` B001 includes fine/long neck expressions; `ح ب ل` B008, necklace ornament; `م س د` B002, compactly formed body, especially woman/girl; `م س د` B007, arrangement of hair; earlier `ل ه ب` B008, striking beauty or abundant hair. Structural cue: the surface places `حَبْل` on `جِيد`, the position of adornment, but specifies `مَسَد` rather than precious material. Assigned role: beauty/adornment branches provide the expected social display that is downgraded into twisted fiber. Abductive move: I infer a reversal from ornament to humiliation because the local material is coarse rope and the context is firewood-bearing. Reading change: the ayah reads not simply as bondage but as anti-adornment: status display becomes punitive equipment.

4. **The rope is a snare that catches the trapper.** Branch evidence: `ح ب ل` B005, snare that catches and entangles; `ص ل ي` B005, snares and traps; earlier `ي د ي` B001, hand caught in a snare; `س م و` B006, going out to hunt; `ك س ب` B003, predatory/hunting creatures called earners. Structural cue: hunting/trapping branches appear across roots in the packet, while the final image fixes the rope on the woman herself. Assigned role: the rope shifts from tool to consequence. Abductive move: I infer a reversal in which the one participating in capture/entanglement is herself caught. Reading change: the final line becomes a trap-reversal scene, not only a static collar.

5. **The family/body cord is externalized as a punitive lineage line.** Branch evidence: `ح ب ل` B006, pregnancy extending in the womb; `ر ح م` B003, womb; `ح م ل` B002, inward bearing; `ء ب و` B001, fatherhood/nurture; `م س د` B001, twisted rope. Structural cue: the packet moves from mercy/womb and fatherhood to wife/carrying and then a cord at the neck. Assigned role: the rope becomes a displaced kinship/gestation cord. Abductive move: I supply the anatomical-social mapping: a family line that should carry mercy/life is twisted into a visible bond of liability. Reading change: the final ayah can be read as an anti-lineage emblem, where relation itself has become the cord of punishment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md:
- As the final ayah, no later ayah in the packet newly activates it. The retrospective pass instead clarified how earlier ayat converge here: fatherhood (`ء ب و` B001), wife/person (`م ر ء` B001), carrying (`ح م ل` B001/B002/B003), and firewood (`ح ط ب` B001/B003) all terminate in a visible cord.
- The most surprising backward relation is with the basmalah. `ر ح م` B002/B003 and `ح ب ل` B002/B006 show that relation, womb, covenant, and cord are not decorative side branches; they form a failed-bond network that the final rope makes bodily.
- The hunting/trap reading remained exploratory but became more coherent after rereading the whole packet: `س م و` B006, `ك س ب` B003, `ص ل ي` B005, and `ح ب ل` B005 form a distributed capture vocabulary. The weak link is that some hunting branches are remote from the surface forms, but the final rope supplies a visible mechanism for entanglement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A concrete restraint made by skilled twisting.** **Lexical evidence:** `جِيد` has root `ج ي د`, branch `B001` (the neck, especially its front); `حَبْل` has root `ح ب ل`, branch `B001` (an extended cord used for binding or leading); and `مَسَد` has root `م س د`, branch `B001` (fiber, hair, or hide firmly twisted into rope). **Structure:** `فِي` fixes the object at a body location and `مِن` specifies its material, moving from anatomy to instrument to construction. **Role and abduction:** the packet supplies all three physical components; I infer that a firmly twisted leading cord removes the mobility and agency previously expressed by carrying. **Reading change:** the closing image is mechanically precise: the active carrier is now the body bound and led by her own kind of equipment.

2. **The necklace position is converted from adornment to constraint.** **Lexical evidence:** root `ج ي د`, branch `B001`, includes the long or fine neck; root `ح ب ل`, branch `B008`, names a necklace ornament called *habalah*; and root `م س د`, branch `B007`, concerns the fine arrangement or bearing of hair. The woman-image also activates `غ ن ي` branch `B005` from `111:2`, a woman whose husband or beauty makes adornment unnecessary. **Structure:** the cord occupies the conventional neck/ornament zone but is specified as twisted rope. **Role and abduction:** neck beauty, ornament, and grooming are supplied branch images; I infer a positional substitution in which restraint takes the place of display. **Reading change:** `فِي جِيدِهَا` carries an adornment-reversal: the site of social presentation becomes the site where consequence is publicly worn.

3. **The final cord closes a hunter-to-captive reversal.** **Lexical evidence:** `حَبْل`, root `ح ب ل`, branch `B005`, is a snare that catches and can figuratively denote causes of death; branch `B011` adds a calamity or cunning that ensnares its owner. Earlier `كَسَبَ`, root `ك س ب`, branch `B003`, evokes hunting creatures called earners, `يَدَا`, root `ي د ي`, branch `B001`, includes a hand caught in a snare, and `ص ل ي` branch `B005` names traps. **Structure:** hands act, acquisitions accumulate, fuel is gathered, and only at the end does the neck reveal who has been caught. **Role and abduction:** the packet supplies active hunting and passive capture images; I infer that the acquisition-and-gathering system has reversed direction onto its operators. **Reading change:** the rope is the closure of an entrapment plot, not an arbitrary accessory to punishment.

4. **A bond of protection persists only as a binding liability.** **Lexical evidence:** root `ح ب ل`, branch `B002`, is covenant, protection, connection, or a means of access. It is activated by the packet's relational terms: opening `ر ح م` branch `B002` (kinship), `أَبِي` from root `ء ب و` branch `B001` (fatherhood), and `ٱمْرَأَتُهُ` from root `م ر ء` branch `B001` (wife/woman). **Structure:** father-name and spouse connect a household whose wealth fails to avail; the only explicit connection left at the end is a cord at the neck. **Role and abduction:** familial bonds and protective-covenant scope are supplied; I infer that failed protection does not erase connection but converts it into shared exposure and restraint. **Reading change:** `حَبْل` can image the household bond turned inside out: attachment remains, but no longer as security.

5. **The rope condenses prolonged labor into consequence.** **Lexical evidence:** `مَسَد`, root `م س د`, branch `B003`, denotes sustained exertion through night travel; `حَطَب`, root `ح ط ب`, branch `B002`, supplies the night wood-gatherer; and `حَمَّالَة`, root `ح م ل`, branch `B007`, supplies burdened exertion. The direct material sense remains `م س د` branch `B001`, firm twisting. **Structure:** three consecutive final roots move from repeated carrying, to cord, to twist, while the night/exertion branches supply duration. **Role and abduction:** sustained labor and twisting are supplied; I infer that repeated acts are like strands accumulated into the final rope. **Reading change:** `مِن مَسَد` gives the restraint a temporal as well as material composition: it is spun out of an ongoing practice.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists in the clipped focus window, so no later-ayah surprise emerged. Retrospective rereading only sharpened how this final cord gathers earlier hands, earning, fire, and carrying into the endpoint of binding.

findings.text: Boyundaki bükülmüş ip, önceki taşıma sahnesini tamamlayan bir koşum ve yöneltme düzeneğine dönüşür; etkin taşıyıcı artık bağlanan ve götürülen bedendir.
Koruma ve bağ kurma işlevi taşıyan ip, başarısız hane ve akrabalık bağlarını bedende daraltıcı bir yükümlülüğe çevirir.
Boyun ve süs çağrışımları, takı yerini kaba ve bükülmüş bir ipin aldığı bir tersine dönüş kurar; toplumsal gösteriş kısıtlamaya çevrilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi anlam çekirdeğini boyun olarak verir; kaynaklar bunun bütün boynu ya da özellikle ön kısmını gösterebildiğini, ayrıca boynun uzunluğu ve güzelliğiyle ilgili türemiş nitelemelere dayanak olduğunu belirtir. concept_map.definition: Temel anlam boyundur; bazı kaynaklarda boynun ön kısmına, bir kullanımda da boynun uzunluğuna özgülenir. Türemiş kişi nitelemeleri ve bağlı ifade, boynun uzun veya güzel oluşunu belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi avı yakalayan tuzağı, onu kurma ve tuzağa düşme sürecini, kuran ile yakalananı ve buradan gelişen mecazları tek bir işlevsel çekirdekte toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği yakalayan düzenektir; ölüm ve ayartma anlatımları mecaz, avcı-okçu sözleri ise ilişkili kalıplaşmış kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel tuzak çekirdeği; kurma, yakalama, yakalanan av, mecaz ve kalıplaşmış söz yüzlerinden ayrı olarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Avı yakalamak için kurulan ipli tuzak ve bu tuzağı kurarak avı yakalama sürecidir. Tuzağı kuran, tuzağa düşen av, insanı ölüme veya ayartmaya götüren nedenler ve avcılarla ilgili kalıplaşmış sözler bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Avın takılıp yakalandığı ipli tuzak.
Tuzağı kurma, avı onunla yakalama, kuran kişi ve yakalanmış av.
Ölüme veya ayartılmaya götüren nedenlerin tuzağa benzetilmesi.
Tuzak kuran ile ok atan avcı üzerinden korku veya karışıklık anlatan kalıplaşmış sözler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar av tuzağı, tuzakla yakalama, tuzağı kuran ve yakalanan av üzerinde birleşir; ölüm, ayartma ve avcı sözleri de toplu kanıtta yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın düzenek ve yakalama işlevinden oluşan tam çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Avı yakalama işlevini ve ipli tuzak niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Avın düzenek kurularak yakalanması eyleminde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tuzak kurma ve avı yakalama işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölüm nedenlerinin yakalayan tuzaklar gibi sunulduğu mecazda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaçışı engelleyen neden ve ölüm sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ortalığın karışması veya her yandan korku gelmesi

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuşlar için kurulan biçimi ayrıca belirginleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın çekirdeği avın takılıp kaldığı tuzaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İpli tuzağı, avcıyı ve yakalanan avı birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kurulmuş kapanların genel sınıfını ve insanı düşürmeye yönelik kurulumu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yakalamak için önceden kurulan düzenek ortak çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özellikle ipli av tuzağını ve türev rollerini, komşu dal ise kurulmuş kapan sınıfını öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yakalama düzeneğini kurma ve kullanma sürecini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Avın tuzağa takılıp kurtulamaması durumuna ve boyun halkasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tuzağa yakalanma olayı iki dalı birleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düzenek ile yakalama eylemini merkez alır; komşu dal yakalananın takılı kalmış durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; düzenek, kurulmuş kapan ve yakalanma durumu arasındaki sınırı en açık veren üçü seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحبالة والمصيدة وحبل الصيد واحتبال الصيد والحابل والمحتبل وما استعير لأسباب الموت أو حبائل الشيطان وأمثال الحابل والنابل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه حبل العهد والأمان ولا الحمل في البطن
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحبل مصدر حبلت الصيد واحتبلته أي أخذته والحبالة المصيدة وحبائل الموت أسبابه (ayn)؛ الحبالة شرك الصائد والصيد محبول ومحتبل إذا وقع في الحبالة وأنا بين حابل ونابل (jamhara)؛ الحبالة التي يصاد بها والحابل الذي ينصب الحبالة والمحبول الوحشي الذي نشب في الحبالة واحتبله أي اصطاده بالحبالة واختلط الحابل بالنابل (sihah)؛ الحبل مصدر حبلت الصيد واحتبلته إذا نصبت له حبالة فنشب فيها والحبالة المصيدة وثار حابلهم على نابلهم (tahdhib)؛ الحبالة خصت بحبل الصائد والنساء حبائل الشيطان والمحتبل والحابل صاحب الحبالة (mufradat)؛ الحبالة حبالة الصائد واحتبل الصيد إذا صاده بالحبالة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gebeliği, gebe dişiyi, karındaki yavruyu, yavrunun ilerideki yavrusunu ve gebeliğin zaman ya da yerini aynı üreme alanında açıkça sıralar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Gebelik çekirdektir; kuşak içindeki sonraki yavru, gebelik başlangıcının zamanı ve rahimdeki yer ayrı özelleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel gebelik anlamı ile kadın, hayvan, sonraki kuşak ve gebeliğin zamanı ya da yeri için kullanılan sınırlı biçimler ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadın veya dişinin yavru taşıdığı gebelik durumu ve karnındaki yavrudur. Henüz doğmamış yavrunun ilerideki yavrusu ile gebeliğin başladığı zaman veya rahimdeki yer bu çekirdeğin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kadın veya başka bir dişinin karnında yavru taşıması ve gebe olması.
Gebelikte karında bulunan yavrunun kendisinin adlandırılması.
Karındaki yavrunun gelecekte doğuracağı yavru, yani bir sonraki kuşak.
Gebeliğin başladığı zaman veya yavrunun rahimde yerleştiği bölüm.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gebelik, gebe dişi ve karındaki yavru çekirdeğinde birleşir; sonraki kuşak ile gebeliğin zamanı ve yeri de toplu kanıtta belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın durum ile taşınan yavruyu birlikte içeren temel kapsamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Gebelik durumunu ve karında taşınan yavruyu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadın veya başka bir dişinin gebeliğe girmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gebeliğin başlamasını ve dişi katılımcıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Henüz karındaki yavrunun gelecekte doğuracağı sonraki kuşak anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İki aşamalı kuşak ilişkisini açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aynı taşıma görüntüsünü ağacın ürünü ve meyvesine de genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kadın veya dişinin karnında yavru taşıması iki dalın ortak çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal gebeliği bitkisel ürüne de yayar; odak dal ise üreme sürecinin kuşak, zaman ve yer ayrıntılarını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gebeliğin sürmesini, gebe dişiyi ve sonraki kuşağı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Döllenmenin tutunup rahimde sabitlenmesi aşamasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gebeliğin oluşması ve rahimde yavru taşınması ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal başlangıçtaki tutunma aşamasını, odak dal ise gebeliğin daha geniş durumunu ve ilişkili adları anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gebe olma, gebe dişi, sonraki kuşak ve başlangıç zamanı gibi ayrıntıları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rahmin topladığı yavru veya kanı ve bazı anlatımlarda doğum artıklarının atılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Rahimde yavru bulunması ve taşınması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gebelik durumunu ve kuşak ilişkisini, komşu dal rahmin içeriğini ve onun dışarı atılmasını öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; gebelik, rahimde tutunma ve rahmin içeriği arasındaki aşama ve kapsam farklarını gösteren üçü seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حبل المرأة والأنثى والحبلى وما في البطن وحبل الحبلة ووقت الحبل ومحبل الحمل ومستقر الولد بإبدال المهبل عن محبل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحبل الرسن ولا الحبلة النباتية ولا الحلي المسمى حبلة
branches.source_phrase_ar: حبلت المرأة حبلا فهي حبلى وحبل الحبلة ولد الولد الذي في البطن (ayn)؛ حبلت من الإنس وغيرهم وربما سمي ما في البطن بعينه حبلا والمحبل وقت الحبل وحبل الحبلة ما يكون في بطن الناقة التي هي في بطن أمها (jamhara)؛ الحبل الحمل وقد حبلت المرأة فهي حبلى وحبل الحبلة نتاج النتاج وولد الجنين وكان ذلك في محبل فلان أي في وقت حبل أمه به (sihah)؛ حبلت المرأة تحبل حبلا وهي حبلى وحبل الحبلة ولد الولد الذي في البطن والمحبل موضع الحبل (tahdhib)؛ الحبل وهو الحمل وذلك أن الأيام تمتد به (maqayis)؛ المهبل مستقر الولد من الرحم وهو من باب الإبدال وأصله محبل (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm asmasının sürgünü veya kökü, dikenli ağaçların meyvesi, bir ağaç türü ve bölgesel fasulye adını aynı bitki alanında verir; bunlar tek bir botanik gönderge değil, kaynakta yan yana duran ayrı bitkisel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bitki alanındaki kullanımları toplar; asma, ağaç meyvesi ve fasulye yüzleri birbirinin yerine kullanılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak bitki adları ile yalnız hayvanın o bitkiyi otlamasını bildiren yapı birbirine karıştırılmadan ayrı yüzlerde verilir.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm asmasının bir sürgünü veya asmanın kendisi için kullanılan bitki adıdır; ayrıca belirli dikenli ağaçların meyvesini, bir ağaç türünü ve bölgesel olarak fasulyeyi adlandıran ayrı kullanımları vardır.

facets.statement: Üzüm asması, asmanın kökü veya ondan çıkan bir sürgün.
Belirli dikenli ağaçların meyvesi veya benzer bir ağaç türü.
Bölgesel kullanımda fasulye adı.
Bir kertenkelenin bu bitkiyi otladığını bildiren sınırlı niteleme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt üzüm asması ve sürgününü, dikenli ağaç meyvesini, benzer bir ağaç türünü ve bölgesel fasulye adını ayrı bitkisel kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tek bir tür eşitliği kurmadan dalın bitki alanındaki çoklu kapsamını gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Asma çekirdeğini ve ayrı bitkisel adların bulunduğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm asmasının tek bir dalı veya sürgünü anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Asmaya bağlı tek sürgün anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dikenli ağaçların ürünü söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Meyve olmayı ve ağaç grubunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Asmanın tek sürgününü ve ayrıca başka ağaç meyveleriyle fasulyeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üzüm bitkisini, ağacını ve meyvesini genel adlarıyla kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Üzüm asması iki dalın ortak bitkisel alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal üzüm bitkisinin genel adıdır; odak dal asma sürgününden hareket eder ve başka bitkisel adlara da ayrılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Asma sürgünü, ağaç türü ve bölgesel fasulye anlamlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle belirli bir çöl ağacının meyvesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dikenli ağaçların meyvesini adlandırma alanında örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal tek bir ağaç meyvesine özgüdür; odak dalın meyve yüzü daha geniş bir ağaç grubuyla birlikte başka bitki yüzlerine bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Asma sürgünü, ağaç meyvesi ve fasulye gibi belirli göndergeleri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağaç sayılmayan taze ve yeşil bitkilerin genel sınıfını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bitkiler alanına aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bitki ve meyve adlarından oluşur; komşu dal ise ağaç dışı taze bitkilerin genel sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; asma, ağaç meyvesi ve genel yeşil bitki sınırlarını açıklayan üçü seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحبلة من قضبان الكرم وأصل الكرمة وضرب من الشجر وثمر العضاه أو السمر والأحبل بمعنى اللوبياء
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحبلة بمعنى الحلي ولا حبل الحبلة في الحمل ولا الحنبل إذا كان مادة أخرى
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحبلة طاقة من قضبان الكرم والحبل نوع من الشجر مثل السمر (ayn)؛ الحبلة الكرم والأحبل الذي يسمى اللوبياء لغة يمانية (jamhara)؛ الحبلة ثمر العضاه والحبلة القضيب من الكرم وضب حابل يرعى الحبلة (sihah)؛ الكرمة حبلة والحبلة طاق من قضبان الكرم والحبلة ثمر السمر وثمر العضاه والأحبل اللوبياء (tahdhib)؛ الكرم يقال له حبلة وحبلة لأنه في نباته كالأرشية والحبلة ثمر العضاة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolyeye yerleştirilen belirli bir süs parçasını tutarlı biçimde gösterir; bitki ve gebelik kullanımlarıyla yalnız biçim ortaklığı vardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız kolye süsünü kapsar; asma sürgünü, ağaç meyvesi ve sonraki kuşak anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin kolyeye takılan süs anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılardaki benzer biçimleri içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Kolyelere takılan veya kolye dizisine yerleştirilen belirli bir süs parçasıdır.

facets.statement: Kolyenin üzerinde yer alan, biçimlendirilmiş süs öğesi.
Bu parçaların başka süslerle birlikte bir kolye dizisi oluşturması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bunun kolyeye yerleştirilen işlenmiş bir süs olduğu konusunda birleşir; kimi anlatımlar onu kolye dizisinin bir öğesi olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın nesne türünü ve kolyedeki işlevini tam olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Süs olmayı ve kolye üzerinde yer almayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yuvarlak bir süsü veya boncuklu ve gümüş hilalli bütün bir ipi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal boyna takılan dizili süsler alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kolyedeki tek tür parçayı, komşu dal ise yuvarlak süsü veya bütün boncuklu diziyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kolyenin süs öğesinin kendisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki inci arasına ayırıcı boncuk veya taş yerleştirme düzenini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kolyede dizilen küçük süs öğeleri ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal süs parçasını adlandırır; komşu dal parçanın iki inciyi ayıran yerleşim işlevini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malzemesi belirtilmeyen kolye süsüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dizilmiş gümüş boncuk veya gümüş taneciklerden oluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kolyelik boncuk ve süs alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal gümüş malzemeyi ve boncuk dizisini gerektirir; odak dal yalnız kolyeye takılan belirli süs türünü belirtir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; parça, ayırıcı boncuk ve bütün süs dizisi farkını gösteren üç komşu yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve güvenli bir 'kitap veya yazı yeri' anlamı kurmaz: bir yorum biçimi sözcüğü yazılı kayıt sayarken başka yorum, ölümün anne gebe kaldığında yazılmış olmasını ve gebeliğin yerini anlatır. Dal bu yorum ayrılığı olarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yazılı kayıt yorumu ile gebelik zamanı veya yeri yorumu eşitlenemez; yazının yazıldığı genel yer anlamı çıkarılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim kaynaklar arasındaki okuma ayrılığıyla tanımlanır; ona genel kitap, yazı yeri veya gebelik anlamı zorla yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Tartışmalı bir şiir sözünde, bir okumaya göre yazılı kayıt veya yazgının kaydıdır; başka yoruma göre söz, ölümün anne gebe kaldığında yazılmasına ve gebeliğin yer ya da başlangıcına gönderme yapar.

facets.statement: Sözcüğün yazılı kayıt veya yazgının yazıldığı kayıt olarak okunması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt iki yorumu karşı karşıya getirir: yazılı kayıt okuması ile ölüm yazgısını annenin gebe kaldığı ana ve gebeliğin yerine bağlayan okuma.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hurma lifi, hurma yaprağı, deve tüyü veya derisinden yapılan bükülü lif ve ipi hem de ipi ustaca bükme eylemini içerir. Bu nedenle dal yalnızca bir ip adı olarak değil, malzeme, ürün ve yapım eylemini ayıran karma bir alan olarak ele alınmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ad anlamı ile yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen bükme eylemi birbirine karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız lif veya ip anlamını korurken ipi bükme eylemini ve nitelikli ip yapılarını ayrı, yapıya bağlı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Hurma lifi veya yaprağından, deve tüyünden ya da derisinden elde edilen bükülü lif veya iptir; ayrıca ipi sağlam ve düzgün biçimde bükme eylemini ve bu eylemin iyi bükülmüş ürününü kapsar.

facets.statement: Hurma lifi veya yaprağından, deve tüyünden ya da derisinden yapılmış lif veya ipi belirtir.
İpi ustalıkla, sağlam ve düzgün biçimde bükme eylemini belirtir.
Belirli bir yapıda, bükülü lifsi malzemeden yapılmış ipi anlatır.
Niteleme yapısında, bükümü özenle ve sağlam yapılmış ipi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi bükme ve katlama işlemini, çeşitli lif ve deri türlerinden yapılan ipi ve ip bükümünün iyi yapılmasını aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: bükülü lif veya ip; ipi ustaca bükme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın malzeme ve ürün anlamı ile yapıya bağlı bükme eyleminin birlikte temsil edilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Malzemeyi, ip ürününü ve ustaca bükme eylemini birlikte korur.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref resolves against qac_morphemes for this ayah

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
